title: Pure Allure Queen
summary: Allure Queen is a Spellcaster LV archetype that equips opposing monsters as protection shields while climbing from LV3 to LV7. Modern support like Allure Palace and Chaos Allure Queen dramatically accelerates their leveling mechanics, turning equipped targets into Link and Synchro material.

allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Allure Palace Field Spell.

main: Discards a LIGHT or DARK monster to Special Summon itself and copies an Allure Queen name in the GY to equip a monster.
Base LV monster that equips an opponent's Level 3 or lower monster to protect itself and level up.
Mid-tier LV monster that equips an opponent's Level 5 or lower monster when summoned by LV3.
Boss LV monster that equips any opposing monster once per turn for disruption and protection.
Field Spell that sends a card from hand to GY to search or send an Allure Queen to the opponent's field, enabling instant leveling.
Continuous Spell that searches an Allure Queen or Allure Palace on activation and Special Summons equipped monsters to your field.
Draws 2 cards and banishes a DARK Spellcaster for deck consistency.
Adds Allure Palace directly from the Deck to the hand.
extra: Link-3 boss that summons an Allure Queen from Deck/GY and grants Quick Effect equip disruption to all Allure Queens.
